s0001.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, Ri Xuan again fled into the sea; the Prince of Zhennan led all armies in pursuit but did not overtake him and withdrew the troops back to Jiaozhi city.
s0001.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, in the first month of spring, Ri Xuan again fled to sea. The Prince of Zhennan pursued with all armies but failed to overtake him and led the troops back to Jiaozhi city.

s0002.literal: Umar was ordered to lead naval forces to meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships; troops were also dispatched to attack their stockades and break them.
s0002.idiomatic: Umar was ordered to lead the navy to meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships, and troops were also sent to attack and break their stockades.

s0003.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered that throughout the jurisdiction of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat all were to obey Manghudai's command.
s0003.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict placed all within the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat under Manghudai's command.

s0004.literal: On gengyin day the sun was sacrificed to at the Astronomical Observatory.
s0004.idiomatic: On gengyin day the sun was sacrificed to at the Astronomical Observatory.

s0005.literal: Prince Huonichi was granted five hundred liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe; Yudu was granted one thousand liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe.
s0005.idiomatic: Prince Huonichi received 500 liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe; Yudu received 1,000 liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe.

s0006.literal: On xinmao day ministry secretariat officials said: "Initially branch secretariats were given chancellors indistinguishable from the inner secretariat; this was abolished.
s0006.idiomatic: On xinmao day ministry secretariat officials said, "Branch secretariats had first been given chancellors indistinguishable from the inner secretariat, and that practice was abolished.

s0007.literal: Now Manghudai, pingzhang of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, commands a broad territory with manifold affairs; we ask that he again be made chancellor as before.
s0007.idiomatic: Now Manghudai, pingzhang of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, commands a broad territory with manifold affairs; we ask that he again be made chancellor as before.

s0008.literal: " An edict made Manghudai right chancellor.
s0008.idiomatic: An edict made Manghudai right chancellor.

s0009.literal: Qi and Huang prefectures and Shouchang Commandery were placed under the Huguang branch secretariat.
s0009.idiomatic: Qi and Huang prefectures and Shouchang Commandery were placed under the Huguang branch secretariat.

s0010.literal: The plate blocks for Zhongtong notes were destroyed.
s0010.idiomatic: The plate blocks for Zhongtong notes were destroyed.

s0011.literal: On yiwei day rewards were granted for eastern campaign merit: those who followed the imperial carriage had officers and clerks promoted two ranks in honorary office and soldiers given three ingots of notes each;
s0011.idiomatic: On yiwei day rewards were granted for eastern campaign merit: those who had followed the imperial carriage had officers and clerks promoted two ranks in honorary office and soldiers given three ingots of notes each;

s0012.literal: those who followed the imperial grandson had officers and clerks promoted one rank in honorary office and soldiers given two ingots each;
s0012.idiomatic: those who had followed the imperial grandson had officers and clerks promoted one rank in honorary office and soldiers given two ingots each;

s0013.literal: those who died in service had their families given ten ingots.
s0013.idiomatic: the families of those who died in service received ten ingots.

s0014.literal: In all forty-one thousand four hundred twenty-five ingots of notes were dispensed.
s0014.idiomatic: In all 41,425 ingots of notes were dispensed.

s0015.literal: On dingyou day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar on the Emperor's behalf.
s0015.idiomatic: On dingyou day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar in the Emperor's stead.

s0016.literal: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
s0016.idiomatic: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

s0017.literal: An edict relaxed the fishing and hunting prohibitions in Liaoyang, only forbidding the killing of pregnant beasts.
s0017.idiomatic: An edict relaxed fishing and hunting prohibitions in Liaoyang, forbidding only the killing of pregnant beasts.

s0018.literal: On renyin day Goryeo dispatched envoys presenting local products as tribute.
s0018.idiomatic: On renyin day Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products as tribute.

s0019.literal: More than seven hundred bandits of He Prefecture burned and plundered counties of Feng Prefecture; more than ten thousand bandits of Xun Prefecture plundered Mei Prefecture.
s0019.idiomatic: More than 700 bandits of He Prefecture burned and plundered counties of Feng Prefecture, and more than 10,000 bandits of Xun Prefecture plundered Mei Prefecture.

s0020.literal: On guimao day Haidu violated the frontier.
s0020.idiomatic: On guimao day Haidu violated the frontier.

s0021.literal: Imperial son-in-law Changji, Prince Yezhilie, and the two chiliarchs Chaqir and Hedan were all ordered to mobilize troops and follow Prince Shibo on the northern campaign.
s0021.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Changji, Prince Yezhilie, and the two chiliarchs Chaqir and Hedan were all ordered to mobilize troops and follow Prince Shibo on the northern campaign.

s0022.literal: Prince Yilianzhen's dependent households were granted thirty thousand ingots of notes.
s0022.idiomatic: Prince Yilianzhen's dependent households received 30,000 ingots of notes.

s0023.literal: Zhangji raised troops in rebellion; Prince Bayadai dispatched generals in pursuit; they reached Bali Hun but did not overtake him and returned.
s0023.idiomatic: Zhangji raised troops in rebellion; Prince Bayadai sent generals in pursuit to Bali Hun but failed to overtake him and returned.

s0024.literal: On jiachen day Yesu Buqa plotted rebellion; he was arrested, brought to the capital, and executed.
s0024.idiomatic: On jiachen day Yesu Buqa plotted rebellion; he was arrested, brought to the capital, and executed.

s0025.literal: On yisi day the moon encroached upon Jiao.
s0025.idiomatic: On yisi day the moon encroached upon Jiao.

s0026.literal: Eighteen Man cave tribes suffered famine and starvation; more than two hundred died; more than one thousand five hundred ingots of notes were used to purchase grain for relief.
s0026.idiomatic: Eighteen Man cave tribes suffered famine; more than 200 died; more than 1,500 ingots of notes were used to buy grain for relief.

s0027.literal: On bingwu day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
s0027.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

s0028.literal: Pingjiang salt-soldiers were ordered to garrison-farm in eastern and western Huai.
s0028.idiomatic: Pingjiang salt-soldiers were ordered to garrison-farm in eastern and western Huai.

s0029.literal: Hang and Su prefectures suffered great floods year after year; the most destitute were relieved.
s0029.idiomatic: Hang and Su prefectures suffered great floods year after year; the most destitute were relieved.

s0030.literal: On wushen day the moon encroached upon Fang.
s0030.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon encroached upon Fang.

s0031.literal: On jiyou day an edict ordered that Zhongxing and Xiliang must not obstruct or damage canals and irrigation works, and the Two Huai and Two Zhe must not obstruct or damage annual revenue levies.
s0031.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict forbade Zhongxing and Xiliang from obstructing or damaging canals and irrigation works, and the Two Huai and Two Zhe from obstructing annual revenue levies.

s0032.literal: One hundred thousand shi of sea-transported grain was dispatched to relieve famine among troops and civilians of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.
s0032.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of sea-transported grain was dispatched to relieve famine among troops and civilians of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.

s0033.literal: On xinhai day the Utensil and Box Bureau was abolished and merged into the jade-and-gold artisan directorates-general of the various routes.
s0033.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Utensil and Box Bureau was abolished and merged into the jade-and-gold artisan directorates-general of the various routes.

s0034.literal: On guichou day an edict said: "The acting Grand Agriculturist Directorate and the agricultural-promotion garrison-farming directorates of each circuit shall tour to promote cultivation, investigate diligence and laziness, and each year compile the actual record of agricultural-promotion officials of prefectures, subprefectures, and counties for ranking of merit; route intendants, county magistrates, and below are all authorized to decide.
s0034.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict said, "The acting Grand Agriculturist Directorate and the agricultural-promotion garrison-farming directorates of each circuit shall tour to promote cultivation, investigate diligence and laziness, and each year compile the actual records of agricultural-promotion officials in prefectures, subprefectures, and counties for merit ranking; route intendants, county magistrates, and below are all authorized to decide.

s0035.literal: Or those who rely on power to act tyrannically, encroach on official duties, and harm agriculture shall be investigated and punished by the surveillance commissions.
s0035.idiomatic: Those who rely on power to act tyrannically, encroach on official duties, and harm agriculture shall be investigated and punished by the surveillance commissions.

s0036.literal: " Civilians who could cultivate vacant Jiangnan land and public fields were recruited; their corvée and miscellaneous duties were remitted for three years, and their rent payments reduced by one-third.
s0036.idiomatic: Civilians who could cultivate vacant Jiangnan land and public fields were recruited; their corvée and miscellaneous duties were remitted for three years, and their rent payments reduced by one-third.

s0037.literal: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said: "In the Two Huai the land is broad and the people few; consolidating households all fail to pay taxes.
s0037.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said, "In the Two Huai the land is broad and the people few, and consolidating households all fail to pay taxes.

s0038.literal: Moreover, within the jurisdiction are more than seventy cities but only two garrison-farming establishments; it would be appropriate to add agricultural-promotion camp-farming directorates for eastern and western Huai to supervise and compel cultivation.
s0038.idiomatic: Moreover, within the jurisdiction are more than 70 cities but only two garrison-farming establishments; it would be appropriate to add agricultural-promotion camp-farming directorates for eastern and western Huai to supervise cultivation.

s0040.literal: Second month, on dingsi day, the Jizhou grain transport commission was changed to the capital grain transport directorate-general, taking charge of both northern and southern Jizhou transport; the Metropolitan Area capital grain transport directorate-general was to govern only the metropolitan area.
s0040.idiomatic: Second month, on dingsi day, the Jizhou grain transport commission was changed to the capital grain transport directorate-general, taking charge of both northern and southern Jizhou transport; the metropolitan capital grain transport directorate-general was to govern only the metropolitan area.

s0041.literal: The Prince of Zhennan led troops back to Wanjie.
s0041.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan led troops back to Wanjie.

s0042.literal: Umar did not meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships; the generals said supplies were exhausted and the army weary and that the whole force should withdraw; the Prince of Zhennan agreed.
s0042.idiomatic: Umar failed to meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships; the generals said supplies were exhausted and the army weary and urged a full withdrawal; the Prince of Zhennan agreed.

s0043.literal: On wuwu day Li Ting was ordered to muster five thousand Han troops for the eastern campaign.
s0043.idiomatic: On wuwu day Li Ting was ordered to muster 5,000 Han troops for the eastern campaign.

s0044.literal: Ye Li was granted four qing of fields in Pingjiang and Jiaxing.
s0044.idiomatic: Ye Li was granted four qing of fields in Pingjiang and Jiaxing.

s0045.literal: On gengshen day Minister of State Sariman and others presented and read the 《Veritable Records of the Ancestors》; the Emperor said: "Taizong's affairs are as they are; Ruizong has few points that could be changed; Dingzong indeed had no day left over; Xianzong — cannot you alone remember?
s0045.idiomatic: On gengshen day Minister of State Sariman and others presented and read the 《Veritable Records of the Ancestors》; the Emperor said, "Taizong's affairs are as they are; Ruizong has few points that could be changed; Dingzong indeed had no day to spare; Xianzong — cannot you alone remember?

s0046.literal: You should still inquire of those who know.
s0046.idiomatic: You should still inquire of those who know.

s0047.literal: " The escort horses released by the various routes south of Dadu for the campaign were ordered to the capital; the government supplied the price of fodder and grain and had them purchase it themselves, without disturbing the people of the various counties.
s0047.idiomatic: Escort horses released by the various routes south of Dadu for the campaign were ordered to the capital; the government supplied the price of fodder and grain for them to purchase themselves, without disturbing the people of the various counties.

s0048.literal: Famine struck Liaoyang, Wuping, and other places; this year's land taxes and the annual levy of sable furs were remitted.
s0048.idiomatic: Famine struck Liaoyang, Wuping, and other places; this year's land taxes and the annual levy of sable furs were remitted.

s0049.literal: The Cangzhou salt transport canal was dredged.
s0049.idiomatic: The Cangzhou salt transport canal was dredged.

s0050.literal: On xinyou day Manghudai and Huduhu said their armies had suffered famine for three successive years; five hundred shi of grain were granted.
s0050.idiomatic: On xinyou day Manghudai and Huduhu said their armies had suffered famine for three successive years; 500 shi of grain were granted.

s0051.literal: On renxu day the Liaodong Haixi Circuit surveillance commission was abolished and merged into Beijing; the Jiangnan Hugbei Circuit surveillance commission was merged into Jingnan.
s0051.idiomatic: On renxu day the Liaodong Haixi Circuit surveillance commission was abolished and merged into Beijing; the Jiangnan Hugbei Circuit surveillance commission was merged into Jingnan.

s0052.literal: An edict ordered that Jiang-Huai must not capture swans and relaxed prohibitions on fishing lakes.
s0052.idiomatic: An edict forbade Jiang-Huai from capturing swans and relaxed prohibitions on fishing lakes.

s0053.literal: On bingyin day the Prince of Yunnan was granted a gilded camel-knob seal.
s0053.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Prince of Yunnan received a gilded camel-knob seal.

s0054.literal: Nanjing Route was changed to Bianliang Route, Beijing Route to Wuping Route, Western Capital Route to Datong Route, Eastern Capital Route to Liaoyang Route, and Zhongxing Route to Ningxia Fu Route.
s0054.idiomatic: Nanjing Route was changed to Bianliang Route, Beijing Route to Wuping Route, Western Capital Route to Datong Route, Eastern Capital Route to Liaoyang Route, and Zhongxing Route to Ningxia Fu Route.

s0055.literal: The Jiangxi tea transport commission was changed to the capital transport commissioner's office and given charge also of wine and vinegar monopoly taxes.
s0055.idiomatic: The Jiangxi tea transport commission was changed to the capital transport commissioner's office and given charge also of wine and vinegar monopoly taxes.

s0056.literal: The canals and irrigation commission was changed to a transport commission.
s0056.idiomatic: The canals and irrigation commission was changed to a transport commission.

s0057.literal: Jiang-Huai chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia reported that he had built one pagoda and five monasteries from Song palace buildings; as they were completed, an edict granted one hundred fifty qing of land and water domains for their upkeep.
s0057.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia reported that he had built one pagoda and five monasteries from Song palace buildings; as they were completed, an edict granted 150 qing of land and water domains for their upkeep.

s0058.literal: An edict summoned the recluse Liu Yanshen of Gehong Mountain.
s0058.idiomatic: An edict summoned the recluse Liu Yanshen of Gehong Mountain.

s0059.literal: On jiaxu day Gai Prefecture suffered drought; the people were famished; four thousand seven hundred shi of rent was remitted.
s0059.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Gai Prefecture suffered drought and famine; 4,700 shi of rent was remitted.

s0060.literal: On jimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was again made left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch ministry secretariat.
s0060.idiomatic: On jimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was again made left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch ministry secretariat.

s0061.literal: Famine struck Hao and Yi prefectures; one hundred fifty thousand shi of grain was used to relieve them.
s0061.idiomatic: Famine struck Hao and Yi prefectures; 150,000 shi of grain was used to relieve them.

s0063.literal: The capital suffered flooding; government grain was released and its price lowered to sell grain to the poor.
s0063.idiomatic: The capital suffered flooding; government grain was released and sold at reduced prices to the poor.

s0064.literal: Because Jiangnan post-house households were uneven in wealth, officials were ordered to assess them: combined household tax reaching seventy shi was equivalent to one horse, with miscellaneous corvée also remitted;
s0064.idiomatic: Because Jiangnan post-house households were uneven in wealth, officials were ordered to assess them: combined household tax reaching 70 shi equaled one horse, with miscellaneous corvée also remitted;

s0065.literal: single households whose tax exceeded seventy shi who wished to enter post-house service were permitted to do so.
s0065.idiomatic: single households whose tax exceeded 70 shi who wished to enter post-house service were permitted to do so.

s0066.literal: Combined household tax could not exceed ten households; single-household tax had no upper limit of one hundred shi.
s0066.idiomatic: Combined household tax could not exceed ten households; single-household tax had no upper limit of 100 shi.

s0067.literal: On xinsi day West Lake of Hangzhou was made a life-release pond.
s0067.idiomatic: On xinsi day West Lake of Hangzhou was made a life-release pond.

s0068.literal: On renwu day the Prince of Zhennan ordered Umar and Fan Ji to lead the naval forces back first; Cheng Pengfei and Tachu led troops to escort them.
s0068.idiomatic: On renwu day the Prince of Zhennan ordered Umar and Fan Ji to lead the navy back first; Cheng Pengfei and Tachu led troops to escort them.

s0069.literal: Because censorate investigating censors and surveillance commissioners often failed to perform their duties, an edict was issued to admonish them.
s0069.idiomatic: Because censorate investigating censors and surveillance commissioners often failed to perform their duties, an edict was issued to admonish them.

s0070.literal: Imperial grandson Yes Temür, Prince of Yunnan, was ordered to command troops to garrison Dali and other places.
s0070.idiomatic: Imperial grandson Yes Temür, Prince of Yunnan, was ordered to command troops to garrison Dali and other places.

s0071.literal: Third month, on bingxu day Prince Changtong's dependent households suffered famine; three months' grain was supplied.
s0071.idiomatic: Third month, on bingxu day Prince Changtong's dependent households suffered famine; three months' grain was supplied.

s0072.literal: On dinghai day Mars encroached upon the senior minister star of the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0072.idiomatic: On dinghai day Mars encroached upon the senior minister star of the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0073.literal: On wuzi day the moon encroached upon Bi.
s0073.idiomatic: On wuzi day the moon encroached upon Bi.

s0074.literal: The imperial carriage returned to the palace.
s0074.idiomatic: The imperial carriage returned to the palace.

s0075.literal: Songjiang commoner Cao Mengyan wished each year to deliver ten thousand shi of grain to the government, asked to be remitted other corvée, and also sought an official post.
s0075.idiomatic: Songjiang commoner Cao Mengyan wished each year to deliver 10,000 shi of grain to the government, asked to be remitted other corvée, and also sought an official post.

s0076.literal: Sangge memorialized on his behalf; he was remotely appointed vice pacification commissioner of Zhedong Circuit.
s0076.idiomatic: Sangge memorialized on his behalf; he was remotely appointed vice pacification commissioner of Zhedong Circuit.

s0077.literal: Qujing Route's general administration prefecture was changed to a pacification commission.
s0077.idiomatic: Qujing Route's general administration prefecture was changed to a pacification commission.

s0078.literal: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.
s0078.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.

s0079.literal: The Found Property Office was changed to the Found Property Directorate and raised to rank four proper.
s0079.idiomatic: The Found Property Office was changed to the Found Property Directorate and raised to rank four proper.

s0080.literal: The Liaoyang branch secretariat was ordered to mobilize tammaq of Yiqiliesi, Wulua, and Zhachar from Yi Prefecture for the eastern campaign.
s0080.idiomatic: The Liaoyang branch secretariat was ordered to mobilize tammaq of Yiqiliesi, Wulua, and Zhachar from Yi Prefecture for the eastern campaign.

s0081.literal: Li Ting was remotely appointed left vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat, drew his salary, and led Han troops on the campaign.
s0081.idiomatic: Li Ting was remotely appointed left vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat, drew his salary, and led Han troops on the campaign.

s0082.literal: Jiang-Huai branch secretariat official Manghudai said: "It would be appropriate to abolish the system of periodic reassignment of military officers: those who die in service should have honorary rank increased; those who die of illness should be reduced one rank.
s0082.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai branch secretariat official Manghudai said, "It would be appropriate to abolish the system of periodic reassignment of military officers: those who die in service should have honorary rank increased, and those who die of illness should be reduced one rank.

s0083.literal: " The Emperor said: "Although fathers and elder brothers die in service, if sons and younger brothers are not competent, how can they be employed?
s0083.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Although fathers and elder brothers die in service, if sons and younger brothers are not competent, how can they be employed?

s0084.literal: If they are worthy, then even those who die of illness should not be reduced.
s0084.idiomatic: If they are worthy, then even those who die of illness should not be reduced.

s0085.literal: " On xinmao day six guards' Han troops of one thousand two hundred, four hundred newly submitted troops, and four hundred garrison-farming troops were assigned to build the ministry secretariat.
s0085.idiomatic: On xinmao day 1,200 Han troops of the six guards, 400 newly submitted troops, and 400 garrison-farming troops were assigned to build the ministry secretariat.

s0086.literal: The Prince of Zhennan returned with all armies.
s0086.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan returned with all armies.

s0087.literal: Zhang Wenhu's grain ships encountered thirty bandit war vessels; Wenhu attacked them; the killed on both sides were roughly equal.
s0087.idiomatic: Zhang Wenhu's grain ships encountered 30 bandit war vessels; Wenhu attacked them, and the killed on both sides were roughly equal.

s0088.literal: Fei Gongchen and Xu Qing, unable to advance because of wind, both reached Qiong Prefecture.
s0088.idiomatic: Fei Gongchen and Xu Qing, unable to advance because of wind, both reached Qiong Prefecture.

s0089.literal: In all two hundred twenty soldiers were lost, eleven ships lost, and more than fourteen thousand three hundred shi of grain lost.
s0089.idiomatic: In all 220 soldiers were lost, 11 ships lost, and more than 14,300 shi of grain lost.

s0090.literal: On guisi day Prince Shibo was granted fifty thousand liang of silver and ten thousand bolts each of silks and cloth; Ulutai and Jahu'er were granted five thousand liang of silver and one hundred bolts each of silks and cloth.
s0090.idiomatic: On guisi day Prince Shibo received 50,000 liang of silver and 10,000 bolts each of silks and cloth; Ulutai and Jahu'er received 5,000 liang of silver and 100 bolts each of silks and cloth.

s0091.literal: On jiawu day the capture of fawn was forbidden.
s0091.idiomatic: On jiawu day the capture of fawn was forbidden.

s0092.literal: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Neibang Pass; bandit troops gathered in force to block the returning army; the Prince of Zhennan then proceeded from Shanji County toward Lan Prefecture and escaped by a hidden route.
s0092.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Neibang Pass; bandit troops gathered in force to block the returning army; the Prince of Zhennan then proceeded from Shanji County toward Lan Prefecture and escaped by a hidden route.

s0093.literal: On yiwei day because of great wind and snow on the northern frontier the previous year, many cattle and horses under Batu Gurun's command died; one thousand shi of grain were granted.
s0093.idiomatic: On yiwei day because of great wind and snow on the northern frontier the previous year, many cattle and horses under Batu Gurun's command died; 1,000 shi of grain were granted.

s0094.literal: On dingyou day the imperial procession halted at Yehu Ridge; Ashu and Tabudai were ordered to command all troops defending the capital walls.
s0094.idiomatic: On dingyou day the imperial procession halted at Yehu Ridge; Ashu and Tabudai were ordered to command all troops defending the capital walls.

s0095.literal: On jihai day the moon eclipsed Jiao.
s0095.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon eclipsed Jiao.

s0096.literal: On renyin day the Ministry of Rites said: "Barbarian envoys from the Hall of Joint Audience arrive from time to time; officials should be ordered, following the ancient 《Records of Tributary Offerings》, to paint illustrations, and also to inquire into their customs, local products, and distance from their states in li, register and record them — truly a grand event of the age.
s0096.idiomatic: On renyin day the Ministry of Rites said, "Barbarian envoys from the Hall of Joint Audience arrive from time to time; officials should be ordered, following the ancient 《Records of Tributary Offerings》, to paint illustrations and also to inquire into their customs, local products, and distance from their states in li, register and record them — truly a grand event of the age.

s0098.literal: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming Prefecture; Ailu was ordered to lead troops back to Yunnan; Aoluchi returned north with all armies.
s0098.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming Prefecture; Ailu was ordered to lead troops back to Yunnan; Aoluchi returned north with all armies.

s0099.literal: Ri Xuan dispatched envoys to express thanks and presented gold figures in place of himself to bear guilt.
s0099.idiomatic: Ri Xuan sent envoys to express thanks and presented gold figures in his stead to bear guilt.

s0100.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered that throughout the jurisdiction of Jiangxi all were to obey the branch ministry secretariat's command.
s0100.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict placed all within Jiangxi under the branch ministry secretariat's command.
